visual_argument: One unit, one leader in a hundred, carried in school objects a reader already counts by: lit laptops on a hundred desks, open lockers, amber folders among the same desks, amber sheets in staff mailboxes; then a shelf of state guidance with one empty slot and a board room with one amber binder.
build_risk: Frame 4 must keep all twenty nine amber folders visible past a hundred desks and laptops at feed size while the rows fill the frame; occlusion and scale fight each other.
distinct_from_recent: The last three decks were dark staged scenes of kit objects with the headline top left (a parked lot, a cooling yard, wafer boats on a black bench). This deck is lit LOOK V2 colour, nine bespoke worlds and four type placements.
bespoke_note: BESPOKE run: no three-frame audition. The review bound in art_preflight.json is the cold carousel-slide-critic final critique of each selected frame (knowledge/carousel/BESPOKE.md, step 3).
